authorization: Maintainer explicitly approved testing both PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv5_server_det and PP-OCRv5_server_rec in the pending REV-009 choice. Local comparison only; no training or private inputs.
hypothesis: Larger licensed pretrained detector and recognizer may recover current missed or incorrectly read original-pixel text without additional training.
isolated_change: Replace detector, recognizer, then both. Preserve current application assembly, upstream model preprocessing and alphabet, downstream reasoners, marker models, crop behavior and operating thresholds.

conversion.warning_review: Retain every warning. Review actual server warning semantics before native comparison; do not borrow mobile model warning counts.

split_identities.native: Existing 21 owned dev sources, 31 panels, 453 text labels and 838 markers
split_identities.csv: Existing 23 owned sources, 39 panels; 20 train and three dev sources reported separately

metric: Unchanged per-item text detection, exact reading, CER, role and marker matching; all 23 source-level CSV successes/failures, actual value and row matches, false points and missing points. All arms evaluated on native dev and CSV, no cherry-picking. Record model and full-workflow CPU time. This is development evidence, not sealed or production acceptance.

runtime.scope: All processors eligible; cooperative average, not an instantaneous per-core guarantee. Re-evaluate the unchanged baseline under identical threading for fair comparison.

void_predecessor.reason: Pre-inference toolchain check rejected rebuilt console launcher. Verify complete launcher structure against locked pip/Paddle2ONNX plus signed Python, preserving all original package and conversion checks. No source model executed.

detector_parity_retry.reason: Paddle itself rejects 1200 square because feature maps disagree at a stride boundary. Replace only that diagnostic shape with 1280 square. Reuse the four byte-verified exports and completed recognizer parity. No hypothesis, threshold, metric, private/sealed budget or model changed.
